item.title: LectureLens: AI-Powered Study Assistant with RAG & Hybrid Search
item.description: A production-grade Flask application that ingests PDF, DOCX, and PPTX lecture materials, indexes them with ChromaDB vector embeddings and SQLite FTS5 full-text search, then answers natural-language questions via a RAG pipeline powered by NVIDIA's LLaMA 3.3 70B, complete with page-level source citations.

item.title: Operating Systems Explained for Normal People
item.description: What an operating system actually is, why it matters, and how to use Windows, macOS, and Linux like someone who knows what they're doing — no programming required.

item.title: You Don't Need to Be a Programmer to Be a Tech Person
item.description: The real tech skills that put you in the top 10% of your environment — no CS degree required.

item.title: How I Built My Portfolio Website with Hugo from Scratch
item.description: A honest, detailed account of how I built my personal portfolio website from a single HTML file to a full Hugo-powered site with a blog, dark/light theme, animated UI, and automated deployment.

item.title: MediScan AI: Medical Image & Report Assistant
item.description: End-to-end medical imaging pipeline: OpenCV preprocessing → ViT classification → ResNet-18 + IsolationForest anomaly scoring → LLaMA 3.1 70B report generation, served as a FastAPI REST endpoint.

item.title: Hypervisors, KVM & QEMU: A Complete Guide to Virtual Machines on Ubuntu 24.04 LTS
item.description: A deep-dive guide from theory to practice — setting up virt-manager on Ubuntu 24.04 LTS, installing Windows 11, Kali Linux, and Parrot OS as virtual machines, passing GPU drivers, defeating Secure Boot, and fixing every error along the way.

item.title: Document Q&A System
item.description: Production-ready RAG system built with LangChain, FAISS, and Streamlit. Upload PDF, DOCX, or TXT files and ask natural language questions with source citations and conversational follow-up memory.

item.title: AI Research Assistant Agent
item.description: Autonomous AI research agent built with Python, Groq LLM, and Tavily Search API, searches the web, extracts multi-source content, and generates structured, cited research reports with PDF/TXT export.
